cohort: 447 women who gave birth at the obstetric unit of Babcock University Teaching Hospital (BUTH) between August 2020 and February 2022
finding: The overall cesarean section rate at BUTH was high (51.2%), with the largest contributors being multiparous women with a previous cesarean section, nulliparous women with induced labor or pre-labor cesarean section, women with preterm birth, and multiparous women in spontaneous labor.
